plan.title: Add input-bound human relay packets and validated local evidence submission

criteria.description: Relay request issuance binds check definition and current input digest, uses unique bounded-expiry packet identity, publishes pending single-check authority and never executes the requested command. The hashed packet includes command, workdir, timeout, requirements, inputs and excludes from config loaded under the check lock.

Submission validates identity, strict format, declared execution times/results and exact required artifact bytes/hashes; rejects missing, altered, oversized, unsafe-path and symlink artifacts without producing pass; preserves human-relayed provenance.

Expired, replayed, superseded or input/definition-changed submissions cannot pass; concurrent submission/local execution and storage failures preserve one authoritative state and never fall back to older successful relay evidence. Fault injection covers pending archival followed by failed new-request publication, successful original submission and distinct immutable terminal archival; artifact retries use isolated attempt paths.

Valid relay pass satisfies its local check despite unavailable local tools, but stale/expired/corrupt-artifact/nonpassing evidence and other unmet checks block; existing schema2 local and conditional schema1 compatibility remain unchanged. Evaluation rejects now before accepted_at and checks actual stored artifact hashes; unsupported current authority never becomes absence.

CLI issue/submit and status preserve provenance and exit contracts; valid relay supports Stop and pre-push only with other conditions met; submit does not clear NOT VERIFIED and CI-labeled check independently executes and records its actual failure or not-run result.

limitations: Human-relayed evidence is a human claim checked for local identity, input, time and artifact consistency; it is not authenticated remote execution or cryptographic proof of remote input bytes. No SSH, device or remote command is executed.

Relay applies to configured checks. Surface/baseline aggregation is deferred to the later common-report task; real CI environment/templates and observed CI runs are separate work. CI never reuses relay success as an executed result. No separate CI evaluation CLI is introduced; CI uses the actual check --evidence ci exit result, never status/pre-push as a substitute.

Pending issuance supersedes earlier authority for that check. Requests and accepted evidence expire; renewal or a different result requires a fresh packet. Default TTL24h, maximum7d; no waiver feature is added.

Schema2 local before/after semantics and legacy conditional compatibility remain intact; relay uses an explicit separate schema/meaning in the same authoritative check-state slot. Same-user tampering and hostile filesystem races remain outside the security guarantee.

Packet and artifact originals remain local ignored sensitive files. Public examples are synthetic; output excludes raw artifacts and no environment credentials are collected. No installation, settings change, push, tag or release is performed.

Task start requires predecessor close and task-gate begin; completion requires fresh targeted tests, full static analysis, current-file naru check and task verify/close evidence. This preparation is not implementation or completion evidence.
